Summarize this passage in 3 concise sentences: Cloud computing allows organizations to access computing resources such as servers, storage, databases, and networking on demand. Instead of purchasing and maintaining all physical infrastructure themselves, organizations can provision resources from cloud providers as needed. This can improve scalability and reduce the need for large upfront infrastructure investments, although organizations must consider cost management, security, privacy, and vendor dependency.

Summarize this passage in 3 concise sentences: Remote work can eliminate daily commuting and give employees greater flexibility over where and when they perform their work. However, distributed teams can experience communication and collaboration difficulties if processes and tools are poorly designed. Successful remote organizations often rely on clear communication practices, documented workflows, and appropriate collaboration tools.

Summarize this passage in 3 concise sentences: Caching stores frequently accessed data so that future requests can be served more quickly. While caching can significantly reduce latency and workload on underlying systems, cached information can become stale. Cache invalidation and consistency therefore need to be considered when designing a caching strategy.
